text:
maya (PM): quick async check-in for milestone posture -> telemetry-driven fallback + canary rollout + infra dep. please reply with: shipped / slipped / next-step (1 line each). tagging owners: @sam (canary), @jordan (autoscaler infra), @maya (fallback rules).

sam (Eng): Canary rollout: shipped partial canary (10% traffic) to us-west yesterday. CPU stable, latency +5ms. next: bump to 30% after PR reviews are green. :thumbsup:

jordan (Infra): Autoscaler infra: slipped — hit a race in pod shutdown handling that causes KV cache invalidation. root cause next week. plan: patch queued, ETA EOD Tues. will coordinate with @sam for safe scale-down window. :construction:

maya (PM): Telemetry-driven fallback rules: shipped beta rules to staging (prefix mismatch + token-usage spike triggers fallback to smaller-quant model). Need a canary plan for prod and verification playbook.

priya (Eng): Queue: code-review for canary percentage controller still blocking bump. I left inline comments in PR #842. Small change: require 5 successful canary responses with no 5xxs before auto-bump.

sam (Eng): acked priya. I'll address comments tonight, push a new commit. After that we can run the canary job that checks 5 consecutive checks.

alex (Eng): Observability: added a dashboard tile for "fallback trigger reason" and a top5 histogram for triggered user prompts. Dashboards link: https://dash.redwood.dev/d/okrs/fallbacks (read-only). 

maya (PM): Dependencies: infra autoscaler patch blocks canary >30%. If @jordan's patch slips further, we hold prod bump and run controlled surge test instead.

jordan (Infra): Patch ETA is firm for Tue EOD. If we miss that window I'll schedule a maintenance sprint Wed morning and coordinate with support. Will post a deploy-bot message when patch lands.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: autoscaler-patch-v1.2.3 -> staging (1719800500). Manual approval required for prod.

sam (Eng): Quick ask: product validation criteria for fallback correctness? Is 0.5% user impact acceptable during canary?

maya (PM): Target SLIs: no more than 1% visible feature regression in the canary cohort, and rollback within 15m on anomaly. 0.5% is fine for canary. Document results in the thread and tag me.

priya (Eng): I'll add a small harness to simulate token-spike behavior against canary before bump. ETA tomorrow morning.

maya (PM): Summary (for OKR sheet):
- shipped: staging fallback rules, 10% canary in us-west, observability tiles.
- slipped: autoscaler patch blocking >30% bump (ETA Tue EOD).
- next steps: @sam fix PR comments -> bump to 30% after 5-success checks; @jordan land autoscaler patch -> allow >30% auto-bumps; @priya add harness + run token-spike sim; @alex validate dashboard queries and add a short runbook for rollback.

maya (PM): If anything changes ping this thread. otherwise I'll update the OKR spreadsheet with the summary and owners. :spiral_note_pad:
